BiblicalUsage: Binea means fountain, and he is a descendant of Jonathan, named twice in the same line. In 1 Chronicles 8:37 Moza begat Binea, and Rapha was his son, and in 1 Chronicles 9:43 the same line is given again, with Rephaiah in place of Rapha. A man in Saul's family, kept on the record in two chapters.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the double record is deliberate: Jonathan's line mattered to the Chronicler, and Binea's fountain-name runs through it.
